## What landed

- `exports/src/exports/search_query_v2.py` (~1,470 lines): the §4.2
  pipeline — stage-0 identifier (record key / entity id / claim id via
  `claim_ref` / catalog doc id), tier-1 aliases (raw-query case-
  sensitive compare; collapsed word-hits; alias targets resolved),
  tier-1 exact names (places first, records-held then level, parents
  shown; single-name queries resolve records as a FILTER — exact count
  + scoped link, never text hits), tier-2 catalog text (weighted bm25 ×
  `score − ln(prior)` type prior), tiers 2–4 records (name phrase →
  all-words-in-name → place/source words; per-group keyset cursors
  `<group>:<token>` v2; tier order dominates bm25, never cross-
  compartment bm25), stage-5 suggestions (vocabulary edit-distance 1/2,
  first/last letter, kept only when the correction finds strong
  results, always stated), facets with counts (type / collection /
  jurisdiction / source / technology; the unplaced bucket never a
  facet value), `sig.search-results/2` assembly with carried-over
  bounds (200-cp q, ≤50/group, 2 s deadline, 100 KiB wire bound) and
  the DR-C4-09 withdrawal barrier (denied rows never return; denials
  counted under the same deadline into `excluded_records_by_reason`).
  `open`/`open_release`/`close` lifecycle.
- `exports/src/exports/search_benchmark.py` (~420 lines): query-set
  loader (fail-closed), the descriptor-only held-out seal
  (`load_held_out_descriptor` + `verify_held_out_blob` — a mismatched
  blob is refused, never read; `adapt_held_out_queries` maps emitted
  rows), judging (top-3 rank, misleading-top-hit with an honest-allow
  list), `run_benchmark` (dev/release/held-out) and
  `run_release_benchmark`.
- `exports/src/exports/data/search_dev_queries.json`: the committed
  `sig.search-benchmark-queries/1` dev set — 40 persona-derived queries
  mirroring K3 §9 (places, aliases, organizations, typos, records,
  sources, identifiers, documents, negatives), labelled agent-authored.
- `exports/src/exports/cli.py`: additive `sig-exports
  search-benchmark` — release + held-out legs, exit 4 on refusal.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: SIG-REL-014 entry.
- `tests/exports/test_search_query_v2.py`: 26 tests.
